description: Save a catalogue search and receive new matching listings by email, webhook, or a pollable feed. Requires sign-in with buyer access.

channels.description: Where to send new matches. One to five entries. Each entry is a webhook (public https URL), an email address, or mcp_resource (poll the returned feed).

type.description: Deliver matches by HTTP POST to url.

url.description: Public https URL that receives new matches. Private and loopback addresses are rejected.

type.description: Keep matches on a pollable feed. The response includes poll_url.

query.description: Marketplace filter. Prices are US dollars per unit. Omit a field to leave it unset.

bulkDealsOnly.description: When true, only listings that have a bulk price tier.

category.description: Catalogue category. One of: electronics, apparel, home_goods, beauty, sports, kitchenware, office_supplies, toys, food_beverage, tools, other.

condition.description: Condition of the goods: salvage (sold as-is), customer returns, shelf pulls, overstock, or new or refurbished.

maxPrice.description: Maximum unit price in US dollars. 50 means $50.

minPrice.description: Minimum unit price in US dollars. 50 means $50.

minQuantity.description: Minimum units available on the listing.

search.description: Words to match in the listing name, description, brand, or SKU.

sellerCountry.description: Seller country, as stored on the seller account (name or 2-letter code).

sort.description: Result order: newest, price_low, price_high, quantity_low, quantity_high, discount_desc, lot_total_low, or lot_total_high.

name: subscribe_to_query
title: Subscribe to a saved search
